BiblicalUsage: Kedab is the Aramaic word for false, lying. Daniel 2:9 has Nebuchadnezzar telling the wise men they have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a king can smell a lie even when he cannot remember his dream, and God can do far more.
